newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada bonds end weaker but rebound off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Canada bonds end weaker but rebound off early lows.

text.p: Canadian bonds closed weaker on Tuesday, but rebounded sharply off early lows amid a rally in the Canadian dollar and the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady, analysts said.

"The currency and bonds have just done a total turnaround here, a full about face. I think obviously the key was the Fed doing nothing," said Hank Cunningham, a bond trader with First Marathon Securities.
Canada's 30-year benchmark bond closed down C$0.30 to C$108.55 to yield 7.267 percent. The bond had started the session down C$2.25.
